question: Should this PR wait for contributor-supplied live WhatsApp Desktop proof, or can maintainer-supplied validation override the missing proof?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible and the patch is focused, but the reported failure is a real WhatsApp Desktop rendering behavior that unit tests cannot prove.

options.title: Require Live Desktop Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot, recording, logs, or validation transcript from a real WhatsApp group/Desktop client before merge.

options.title: Accept Maintainer Proof Override
options.body: A maintainer with paired WhatsApp access can validate the Desktop flow themselves and explicitly override the contributor proof gate.

options.title: Pause Until Proof Exists
options.body: Keep the PR open but unmerged until someone can produce real WhatsApp Desktop proof.

recommendation.title: Require Live Desktop Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot, recording, logs, or validation transcript from a real WhatsApp group/Desktop client before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is currently assigned to steipete, who also authored adjacent WhatsApp echo-suppression behavior in the affected path.
